#### 패키지 Graphics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
str(cars)
## 'data.frame':	50 obs. of  2 variables:
##  $ speed: num  4 4 7 7 8 9 10 10 10 11 ...
##  $ dist : num  2 10 4 22 16 10 18 26 34 17 ...
plot(cars)
lines(lowess(cars))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}

#### 패키지 ggplot2


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(cars, aes(x = speed, y = dist)) + 
  geom_point() + geom_smooth()
## `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'
```
